{{Quote|A jizz band without a kloo horn should find a new gig.|a popular saying among aficionados|<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
The '''kloo horn''' was a double-reeded wind instrument, larger than a [[Slitherhorn]] and a [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Fizzz]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> (roughly 1.5 meters tall), and one of the most commonly used instruments in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was considered a primary instrument for musicians specializing in the field of [[Jizz/Legends|Jizz]] or [[Jatz/Legends|Jatz]]. The mouthpiece of a kloo horn extended into a handheld "S" shaped body where players could use their hands to make adjustments for tone and pitch. The average kloo horn weighed approximately 1.2 kilograms. By the pricing standards used late in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a well-kept kloo horn could be purchased for roughly 2,000 [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

Notable kloo horn players included:
*[[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]] and [[Lirin Car'n/Legends|Lirin Car'n]] of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]<ref name="TCSWE" />
*[[Banjaxx Wab]] of [["Smooth" Banjaxx Wab and the Scundereds]]<ref name="TLAOTH">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>
*[[Umjing Baab]] of [[Umjing Baab and His Swinging Trio]]
*[[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]] of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]
*[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Leonie]] of [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]
*[[Jimke Weet]], father of the ill-fated [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Salak Weet]]
*In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the [[Tailfin Cantina]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] had an interpreter of kloo horn providing entertainment.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Rebel Alliance intelligence chief [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] once escaped Imperial detention by claiming to be a Kloo horn player.

The available pieces for kloo horn included [[The Hutt Two-Step]].<ref name="BL" />
